notes.title: Disney Infinity 3.0: Gold Edition - Dec. 16th Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118089/3b82f9722f3251efcc405d4e328555732daa0fb2.png

Disney Infinity 3.0: Gold Edition - December 16, 2016 Update
We are happy to have addressed some of the most requested changes. 

Fixes Include:
- Judy Hopps & Nick Wilde from Zootopia have been Unlocked
- Game can now run in Offline Mode
- Fixed general performance issues (including one affecting the General Grievous fight)
- Turned on Vsync

Thanks for your continued support.
